title: Circuit binarization
statement: A well-formed circuit is one in which every gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For any well-formed circuit, its binarization is the circuit obtained by rewriting each gate using the gate-binarization construction, with the resulting circuit retaining the same number of inputs.
hypotheses_covered: The input circuit is well formed: each gate has distinct arguments, and each NOT gate has exactly one argument.
caveat: The exact rewrite operation and correctness argument are referenced but not defined in the supplied snippet, so the precise resulting gate sequence cannot be stated from this payload alone.
